በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
፫፻፲ወ፰: ፫፻፲ወ፰ — 318, spoken ሠለስቱ ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወሰመንቱ (śälästu məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-sämäntu) 'three hundred and eighteen' (numeral)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ)
ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ)
ለንግሥት: ንግሥት — to the queen (ለ- + noun, fem.)
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
ለጥበብ: ጥበብ — to wisdom, of wisdom (ለ- + noun; names the object or possessor already marked by a suffix)
ወትነብር: ነበረ — and she sits, dwells (ወ- + 3fs imperfect)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing')
ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ዘእንበሌሁ: ዘእንበለ — besides him, without him (preposition, stem ዘእንበሌ- + -ሁ 'him')
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem.; construct 'day of'; plural መዋዕል)
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
ወየውሀት: የውሀት — and meekness, gentleness (ወ- + noun, from የዋህ)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ወትጤይቅ: ጠየቀ — and she examines, investigates (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G)
ወታነክር: አንከረ — and she marvels (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, causative of ነከረ 'be strange')
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people')
ወበዘ: ዘ — and in that which, whereby (ወ- + በ- + relative ዘ)
ለአምላከ: አምላክ — of the God of (ለ- genitive + noun, construct)
ወታስተዐጽብ: አስተዐጸበ — and she reckons hard, finds difficult (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, ʾastä-stem; the same verb as ch. 22 ያስተዐጽብ 'he marvelled, was astonished'; sense unconfirmed) (?) · also 'she is astonished' (ወታስተዐጽብ ፈድፋደ 'and she was astonished exceedingly', ch. 25)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ቤተ: ቤት — house of (noun, construct) · accusative 'a house' (አተወት ቤተ 'she settled in a house') · ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church' (lit. 'house of Christians')
ዘርእየት: ርእየ — what she saw (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G)
ለሊሃ: ለሊሃ — she herself (emphatic pronoun, 3fs; the masculine is ለሊሁ)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
ለውእቱ: ውእቱ — of that, that (ለ- 'of, to' + demonstrative ውእቱ before a noun: ለውእቱ መጽሐፍ 'of that book')
ወይፌኑ: ፈነወ — and he would send (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G; habitual 'would send')
ወመሳትየ: መስተይ — and drinking vessels (ወ- + plural መሳትይ of መስተይ, accusative; from ሰትየ 'drink') (?)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
